product.name: Matano Cloud-Native SIEM
product.description: A cloud-native security information and event management platform built on a data lake for scalable, cost-effective security analytics and threat detection.

product.name: Matano Security Data Lake
product.description: A scalable security data lake that centralizes normalized security data with decoupled storage and compute for long-term retention and large-scale analytics.

product.name: Matano for Snowflake
product.description: An integration that enables security analytics by unifying business and security data within Snowflake without ETL, optionally using existing Snowflake compute resources.
